title: Hold an electrical contractor licence
what: Conduct a business or undertaking that includes electrical work only while holding an electrical contractor licence.

sources.title: Electrical Safety Act 2002 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a business or undertaking that includes the performance of electrical work unless the person is the holder of an electrical contractor licence that is in force
